'''Lice''' are small infector [[Mobs|Mobs]] in the [[Inborn Parasites|Inborn]] Tier. They have several tentacles coming out from what can be assumed to be a maw. Said tentacles can also be seen when it has borrowed into a sane mob and turned it Feral. It has an amorphous body structure, mostly being a ball of biomass with bump features and a ringed skin. 

==''Spawning''==
*Spawns in groups of 1 to 4 from [[Evolution Phases#Phase 3|Phase 3]] and onwards with a spawnweight of 20.
*Spawned by [[Adapted Vermin]].

== ''Behavior'' ==
Lice are short lived Aerial Infestation Propagators and swarm units. They are Melee Combatants. They are used for specialized forms of [[Call Of The Hive|Assimilation]].

* They gently float around their target before charging quickly at them.
** Their Melee Attack is performed through contact damage, inflicting stacking [[Viral]].
*** Lice disappear into a cloud of gore after dying or attacking once.
* Lice will turn any mob they kill [[:Category:Feral Parasites|Feral]], assuming it has a Feral form.
** Mobs with an [[:Category:Assimilated Mobs|Assimilated]] but no Feral form will assimilate instead.
** Any mob with a [[:Category:Hijacked Mobs|Hijacked]] form will become Hijacked when attacked by one and has below 50% health.

=== ''Weaknesses'' ===

* Lice, like any other [[Mobs|Mob]], present a weakness to Fire. Damage inflicted by Fire is quadrupled.
* Lice die after existing for one minute.
